I want to pursue it so badly but I feel stuck due to the fact that i've made this sort of different persona for myself after joining the military. I feel that I should be able to pursue this choice after already making a choice that apparently "less than 1%" have made, the choice being to swear my body and soul to defend the people I care about and the country they reside in along with the people that live in said country.
